text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock E and D at gains and later bought them again; I should not let the pleasure of realizing gains or the pain of losses replace a consistent, forward-looking reason to trade.","My trades so far do not show that recent price moves predict what comes next. I should base decisions on risk, diversification, and my investment plan—not on price history or my average cost.","I rarely trade and can tolerate doing nothing: I should check that my portfolio still fits my goals, then hold when there is no compelling reason to act."]}
